# Mweshi

> A public demo of a streaming home for AI-made series, built for watching episodes in order. The demo is open. A catalogue of licensed AI series is not live yet.

## Docs

- [soul.md](https://mweshi.com/soul.md): what Mweshi is, what it isn't, creator commitments, open questions, and contact
- [Homepage](https://mweshi.com/): the human-facing site
- [Demo player](https://mweshi.com/watch/): working player with stand-in footage
- [Founder letter](https://mweshi.com/letter/): why Mweshi exists
